    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { margin: 0; background: transparent; }
    body { padding: 24px 28px 28px; font-family: "OSB Barlow","Avenir Next", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; }
    .osb { position: relative; width: 620px; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: #fbf8f0; color: #10241c; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px #0009; }
    .ev { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 7px 14px 6px; background: #0f3b2e; color: #f3e3b5; font-family: "OSB Barlow Condensed","Avenir Next Condensed", "Roboto Condensed", "Arial Narrow", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .8px; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; }
    .ev .eventName { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
    .ev .matchRound { flex: none; }
    .ev .matchRound { color: #e2b23a; }
    .row { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 12px 26px minmax(0, 1fr) 166px 100px; align-items: center; height: 60px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fffdf8, #f1ecdf); }
    .row + .row { border-top: 1px solid #e3dccb; }
    .kitw { align-self: stretch; display: flex; background: #9aa7a0; }
    .row.b .kitw { background: #3e4d46; }
    .kit { flex: 1; background-color: transparent; }
    .poss { position: relative; z-index: 3; display: flex; justify-content: center; }
    .arrow { width: 0; height: 0; border-top: 7px solid transparent; border-bottom: 7px solid transparent; border-left: 10px solid #c8962a; }
    .nm { padding-right: 6px; font-family: "OSB Barlow Condensed","Avenir Next Condensed", "Roboto Condensed", "Arial Narrow", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 23px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.02; text-transform: uppercase; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; overflow: hidden; overflow-wrap: normal; word-break: normal; hyphens: none; text-wrap: balance; }
    .info { position: relative; align-self: stretch; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 68px 1fr; grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr; align-items: center; column-gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px 6px 0; }
    .info > .bslot { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / span 2; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
    .info > .tor, .info > .fl { grid-column: 2; justify-self: end; }
    .tor { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
    .cap { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; color: #3d4a43; }
    .pips { display: flex; gap: 4px; height: 12px; }
    .pip { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #c8962a; }
    .fl { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; color: #3d4a43; }
    .fl b { font-size: 16px; color: #10241c; }
    .bonus { display: block; width: 68px; text-align: center; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; padding: 5px 0 4px; line-height: 1; border-radius: 3px; background: #0f3b2e; color: #f3e3b5; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #e2b23a; }
    .bonus:empty { visibility: hidden; }
    .to { position: absolute; z-index: 2; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; flex-direction: row; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 0 10px 0 14px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0f3b2e, #174f3e); color: #f3e3b5; line-height: 1; }
    .to-l { font-family: "OSB Barlow Condensed","Avenir Next Condensed", "Roboto Condensed", "Arial Narrow", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; }
    .row:has(.to[style*="opacity: 1"]) { box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 #e2b23a; }
    .to-c { font-family: "OSB Barlow","DIN Alternate", "Roboto Condensed", "Arial Narrow", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: #10241c; background: #e2b23a; padding: 4px 8px 2px; border-radius: 3px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .pts { position: relative; z-index: 1; align-self: stretch; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #0f3b2e; color: #fff; font-family: "OSB Barlow","DIN Alternate", "Roboto Condensed", "Arial Narrow", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .row + .row .pts { border-top: 1px solid #1d5544; }
    .bar { display: grid; height: 64px; background: #10241c; color: #fff; }
    .bar > * { grid-area: 1 / 1; }
    .live { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; padding: 0 14px; }
    .lft { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
    .per { font-family: "OSB Barlow Condensed","Avenir Next Condensed", "Roboto Condensed", "Arial Narrow", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #10241c; background: #e2b23a; padding: 2px 9px 1px; border-radius: 3px; }
    .gc { font-family: "OSB Barlow","DIN Alternate", "Roboto Condensed", "Arial Narrow", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .gc b { color: #e2b23a; padding: 0 1px; }
    .shot { position: relative; justify-self: end; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 40px; padding: 0 4px 0 9px; background: #c22a35; color: #fff; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.2px; }
    .shot-v { font-family: "OSB Barlow","DIN Alternate", "Roboto Condensed", "Arial Narrow", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; background: #10241c; border-radius: 3px; min-width: 40px; padding: 0 4px; line-height: 32px; text-align: center; }
    .run-shot { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -5px; height: 2px; background: #ff7a84; }
    .runbar { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: 3px; background: #e2b23a; }
    .prog { display: flex; gap: 3px; align-items: center; }
    .q { position: relative; width: 14px; height: 5px; background: #31473d; }
    .q > span { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: #e2b23a; }
    .ot { width: 20px; height: 5px; margin-left: 2px; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; font-size: 16px; line-height: 5px; border-radius: 1px; background: #e86b3a; color: transparent; }
    .state { z-index: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; background: #e2b23a; color: #10241c; line-height: 1; font-family: "OSB Barlow Condensed","Avenir Next Condensed", "Roboto Condensed", "Arial Narrow", Arial, sans-serif; }
    .st-s { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; }
    .st-b { font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; }
    .fin { z-index: 2; background: #0f3b2e; color: #fff; border-top: 3px solid #e2b23a; }
    .fin-ot { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.5px; color: #e2b23a; }
    .half-t { display: none; }
    .osb:has(.isGame2Started[style*="opacity: 1"]):not(:has(.isGame3Started[style*="opacity: 1"])) .brk .end-t { display: none; }
    .osb:has(.isGame2Started[style*="opacity: 1"]):not(:has(.isGame3Started[style*="opacity: 1"])) .brk .half-t { display: block; }
    .fin-ot { display: none; }
    .osb:has(.isGame5Started[style*="opacity: 1"]) .fin-ot { display: block; }
    .osb:has(.isComplete[style*="opacity: 1"]) .final-dim { opacity: .55; }
    .osb:has(.isComplete[style*="opacity: 1"]) .info > :not(.to) { visibility: hidden; }
    .tor:not(:has(.pip[style*="opacity: 1"])) { visibility: hidden; }
    .win { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 100px; background: #e2b23a; }
    .row:has(> .win[style*="opacity: 1"]) .pts { background: transparent; color: #10241c; }
    .osb:has(.isAWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) .row.b .nm, .osb:has(.isBWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) .row.a .nm { color: #59665f; }
    .osb:has(.isAWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) .row.b .pts, .osb:has(.isBWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) .row.a .pts { background: #5d7268; color: #fff; }
    .osb:has(.isAWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) .row.b .kitw, .osb:has(.isBWinner[style*="opacity: 1"]) .row.a .kitw { opacity: .5; }
    .pips { gap: 0 !important; }
    .pips > [class*="TimeoutLeft"] { margin-right: 4px; }
    .pips > [style*="opacity: 0"] { width: 0 !important; margin: 0 !important; }
    .pips > .pip[style*="opacity: 0"] { display: none !important; }
    .osb-aux { display: none; }
    .point-slot:has(> .isMatchPoint[style*="opacity: 1"]) > .isGamePoint { opacity: 0 !important; }
    .combinedAName:empty::before { content: "Team A"; }
    .combinedBName:empty::before { content: "Team B"; }
    .eventName:empty, .matchRound:empty { display: none; }
    .ev:not(:has(.eventName:not(:empty))):not(:has(.matchRound:not(:empty))) { display: none; }
    .ev-sep { display: none; }
    .ev:has(.eventName:not(:empty)):has(.matchRound:not(:empty)) .ev-sep { display: inline; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; } }
/* stream-size floor: text >= 16px, indicators >= 12px at 1280x720 */
.ev-n.eventName,.ev-r.matchRound,.fl,.ot.isGame5Started,.shot.isShotClockActive,.bonus.bonusA,.bonus.bonusB{font-size:16px!important}
.arrow.isAPossession,.arrow.isBPossession{width:12px!important;height:14px!important;min-width:0!important;flex-shrink:0!important}
.pip.isATimeoutLeft1,.pip.isATimeoutLeft2,.pip.isATimeoutLeft3,.pip.isATimeoutLeft4,.pip.isATimeoutLeft5,.pip.isBTimeoutLeft1,.pip.isBTimeoutLeft2,.pip.isBTimeoutLeft3,.pip.isBTimeoutLeft4,.pip.isBTimeoutLeft5{width:12px!important;height:12px!important;min-width:0!important;flex-shrink:0!important}
/* end stream-size floor */
